quirks.condition: Service X shipment whose zone is 40 to 49 inclusive and whose billable weight is strictly above 750 kg.
quirks.effect: The express surcharge is 65% of the amount it applies to instead of the published 50%; zones 39 and 50 and a billable weight of exactly 750 kg get the ordinary 50%.

quirks.condition: Class 050 or 055 shipment whose dimensional weight (computed with the engine's own 5500 divisor and half-up rounding) is strictly greater than the actual weight.
quirks.effect: The class multiplier is raised to 0.70 (as if the class were 070) instead of 0.50 or 0.55; when the actual weight is at least the dimensional weight the published multiplier applies.

quirks.condition: Any accepted shipment (dimensional weight computed from length times width times height in cubic cm).
quirks.effect: The volume is divided by 5500 to obtain kg instead of the documented 5000, so the dimensional weight is lower than the spec's figure.

quirks.condition: Any accepted shipment whose volume divided by the dimensional divisor leaves a remainder.
quirks.effect: The dimensional weight rounds to the nearest whole kg with halves rounded up (a remainder of at least 2750 out of 5500 adds one kg, and a volume below 2750 cubic cm yields 0 kg) instead of always rounding up to the next kg; the same rounded figure decides whether the dimensional weight governs.

The express surcharge is added to the base (billable kg times zone rate, surcharge rounded half-up to the cent) before the class multiplier is applied to the surcharged amount, instead of the spec's order of class multiplier first and surcharge on the class-multiplied amount; this changes the cents figure whenever the two roundings differ.

quirks.condition: Service P shipment whose 25% surcharge on the class-multiplied amount lands exactly on a half cent.
quirks.effect: The surcharge in cents rounds half to even (for example 280.5 becomes 280 and 281.5 becomes 282) instead of half up, while still being computed on the class-multiplied amount as the spec says.

quirks.condition: Accepted shipment in zone 99, any service level.
quirks.effect: A flat 12500 cents is added after the class multiplier and service surcharge, and the amount counts toward the trailer total; zones 90 to 98 add nothing. The spec has no such fee.

quirks.condition: Shipment whose weight field is 0 while all three dimensions are nonzero.
quirks.effect: The shipment is accepted and rated on its dimensional weight (yielding 0 cents when the volume is under 2750 cubic cm) instead of being rejected WEIGHT; weight 0 together with a zero dimension still rejects WEIGHT.

quirks.condition: Input line with more than nine whitespace-separated tokens whose first nine tokens are well formed.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the shipment is rated normally instead of being rejected FMT for wrong token count; a line with fewer than nine tokens is still rejected FMT and echoes the second token as the shipid when that token is 1 to 10 alphanumerics.
